name: shop
description: Customers, products, orders with a status enum and order lines; money must be numeric and quantities positive.

input.requirements: An online shop. Customers have a unique email and a name. Products have a unique sku, a name, a price (money, never negative) and a stock count (never negative). A customer places orders; an order has a status that is one of pending, paid, shipped or cancelled (default pending), and a total. An order has order_items: each links an order to a product with a quantity (at least 1) and the unit_price at the time of ordering. A product can appear only once per order.
